title: ISS Vanguard
subtitle: An epic cooperative sci-fi exploration campaign across uncharted star systems
tagline: Chart the unknown, command the Vanguard, uncover humanity's cosmic origins
loreSummary: Humanity discovered coordinates hidden inside junk DNA. Across countless light-years, the crew of the starship ISS Vanguard embarks into the dark expanse to find the creators of that message.
keyFeatures: Dual-phase campaign alternating planetary exploration with in-depth ship management
Four specialized ship sections: Security, Recon, Science, and Engineering
Customizable crew development, dice customization, and equipment production
Rich planetary binders, branching story logs, and cosmic mysteries

issv_standard.name: Standard Campaign Expedition
issv_standard.description: The complete primary campaign path balancing core planetary discoveries, critical sector anomalies, and essential ship upgrades.

issv_story.name: Expedited Odyssey (Core Path)
issv_story.description: A streamlined narrative route prioritizing main mission objectives and vital planetary landings to reach the cosmic finale.

issv_completionist.name: Master Explorer (All Sectors & Systems)
issv_completionist.description: Comprehensive deep-space chronicle visiting every optional planetary landing site, maximizing research breakthroughs, and upgrading all ship compartments.

milestones.title: Departure & Maiden Voyage
milestones.description: Launching the Vanguard into uncharted space, conducting initial planetary landings and unlocking crew specialization protocols.

milestones.title: Echoes of the Precursors
milestones.phase: Deep Space Reconnaissance - The Alien Signal
milestones.description: Unraveling cryptic celestial coordinates left in human DNA, exploring anomalous worlds and upgrading key ship systems.

milestones.title: The Cosmic Threshold
milestones.description: Surviving catastrophic deep-space hazards and hostile planetary ecosystems while assembling the final star-gate coordinates.

milestones.title: Destiny of Humankind
milestones.phase: Deep Space Reconnaissance - The Core Truth
milestones.description: Executing the ultimate deep-space expedition to decipher the true origin and purpose encoded in the stars.
